# WB28 · Hôm nay · Vắng hẹn

Group **WB · Vận hành: tổng quan, hôm nay, lịch** · state · Next.js: **restyle (U1)** (`/today`) · account `owner-tam`

## Logic source
- Old web: `prototype/shared/crm-ui.js#today`
- Operations pages are drawn by `crm-ui.js` (dashboard, today) and `operations-ui.js` (schedule and the booking dialogs); calculations live in `PemaCRM` and `PemaOps` (`operations-data.js`).
- `crm-ui.js › today()`: the six status tiles (`data-crm="today-status"`) filter the reception table by `a.status`; the status badge uses `statuses[a.status]` and the last column offers the next reception action. "Vắng hẹn" = `missed`: reached with "Vắng" on the first row; the badge is drawn with the highlighted flag (the same flag as "Đang chờ").
- Page key `today` is allowed for roles: owner, doctor (`staff-context.js` › pages). Shown here with account `owner-tam`.
- Capabilities (`staff-context.js` › capabilities): clinical: owner/doctor; crm: owner/care/doctor; booking: owner/care/doctor; billing: owner/accountant; config: owner; readFinance: owner/accountant/doctor.
- No control on this screen is removed by a capability check.
- How to reach it in the old web: {"goto":"/clinic-web/?staff={role}"} → {"click":".sidebar [data-nav=\"today\"]"} → {"click":"tr:has([data-crm=\"profile\"][data-id=\"P001\"]) [data-crm=\"missed\"]"} → {"click":"[data-crm=\"today-status\"][data-id=\"missed\"]"}; it must show "Vắng hẹn".
